spans.s:
āśrama, m.
 —1. (place of self-castigation,
 i. e.) hermitage;
 —2. stadium in a
Brahman's religious life (of which there
are four: that of the student or brahmacārin,
that of the householder or gṛhastha,
that of the hermit or vānaprastha,
and that of the beggar or bhikṣu), see
65^3N. [√śram + ā.]

āśraya-bhūta, a. having become a protection,
 i. e., as m., protector. [1273c.]
